name: Neural Assets Capture and Rendering Pipeline
definition: A method for capturing real-world objects using consumer hardware (mobile phone) and rendering them as volumetric assets in interactive environments, separating foreground object from background using two radiance field models.
summary: Neural Assets Capture and Rendering Pipeline captures real-world objects via mobile video and renders them as volumetric assets by transpiling neural models into GLSL/HLSL shaders for real-time interactive game engine integration.
